headline: The paid engine works. Now the job is turning 7,500 video views into follows and jobs.
read: First real performance read is in, and it's a split screen. The paid side is working: the $7/day video-view campaign has pulled ~7,500 views and 5,000+ reach for under $40, which is exactly the cheap retargeting pool the plan called for. The organic side is still cold — 2 Facebook followers, engagement in the single digits — but that's normal for a page barely two weeks past warm-up, and every channel is fed. We're not thin on content: 67 blog articles, 92 in the syndication queue fanning out to 13 channels with unique native copy per channel, 94 FB posts and 15 reels still queued. The gap isn't production, it's conversion — a big warm-viewer pool that nobody has been asked to follow yet. This week we deepened the money cluster with a new head-to-head (Angi vs Thumbtack vs HomeAdvisor) built on the fact most contractors don't know: Angi and HomeAdvisor are the same company.
next_move: Convert, don't just produce. (1) Point the paid budget's next move at a retarget→Page-Like/follow ad against the 25/50/95% watchers we've already built — the pool exists, it's idle. (2) Keep the money cluster compounding; next posts from this week's research: 'Angi is shrinking' (2026 revenue -13% to $1.03B, 350 layoffs, April-2025 IAC spinoff), the Jan-2025 'homeowner choice' lead-model change and what it did to lead quality, and a scam-cluster piece on Thumbtack's 1,000+ BBB complaints / chargeback-deactivation trap. (3) Still zero real named contractor quotes in the inbox (only IG spam) — keep the /share-your-story/ + FB prompts running so phase-2 EEAT has real voices to pull. Ad video-views target raised 6k→45k to match reality.
